description: This file defines the interface for the Starboard socket module, including socket types, error codes, address structures, and function declarations for socket operations such as create, connect, bind, listen, accept, send, receive, and configuration options. It also includes socket resolution and multicast group functions, with all functions marked as deprecated in version 16.

methods.name: SbSocketCreate
methods.description: Creates a new non-blocking socket for specified protocol and address type.

methods.name: SbSocketDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a socket, closing connections and freeing resources.

methods.name: SbSocketConnect
methods.description: Opens a connection to a specified host and port.

methods.name: SbSocketBind
methods.description: Binds a socket to a local address and port.

methods.name: SbSocketListen
methods.description: Sets a socket to listen for incoming connections.

methods.name: SbSocketAccept
methods.description: Accepts a pending connection on a listening socket.

methods.name: SbSocketIsConnected
methods.description: Checks if a socket is connected.

methods.name: SbSocketIsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if a socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: SbSocketGetLastError
methods.description: Retrieves the last error on a socket.

methods.name: SbSocketClearLastError
methods.description: Clears the last error on a socket.

methods.name: SbSocketGetLocalAddress
methods.description: Gets the local address a socket is bound to.

methods.name: SbSocketGetInterfaceAddress
methods.description: Gets the source address and netmask for a destination.

methods.name: SbSocketReceiveFrom
methods.description: Reads data from a socket, optionally capturing source address.

methods.name: SbSocketSendTo
methods.description: Sends data to a specified destination address.

methods.name: SbSocketSetBroadcast
methods.description: Sets broadcast option on a socket.

methods.name: SbSocketSetReuseAddress
methods.description: Sets reuse address option on a socket.

methods.name: SbSocketSetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets receive buffer size.

methods.name: SbSocketSetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets send buffer size.

methods.name: SbSocketSetTcpKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables/disables TCP keep-alive with period.

methods.name: SbSocketSetTcpNoDelay
methods.description: Disables/enables Nagle's algorithm.

methods.name: SbSocketSetTcpWindowScaling
methods.description: Sets TCP window scaling.

methods.name: SbSocketJoinMulticastGroup
methods.description: Joins a socket to a multicast group.

methods.name: SbSocketResolve
methods.description: Resolves a hostname to addresses.

methods.name: SbSocketFreeResolution
methods.description: Frees a resolution object.
